items.label: Latest Android 15 System
items.value: Dghrti tablet runs Android 15, effortlessly handling daily apps and games with smooth performance, seamless multitasking, and fewer ad interruptions

items.label: Generous Storage
items.value: This Android tablet offers 30GB RAM (8GB+22GB virtual) + 128GB ROM (expandable up to 1TB), ensuring fast app launches and smooth operation. Pre-installed Google Play allows easy downloading of essential apps

items.label: HD IPS Display + Widevine L1 Certified
items.value: The 10.1-inch tablet features an FHD IPS screen with 1280x800 resolution, offering wide viewing angles and sharp visuals. Supports smooth Full HD streaming on platforms like Prime Video

items.label: 8000mAh Battery + Keyboard & Mouse
items.value: Equipped with a long-lasting 8000mAh battery, this tablet with mouse and keyboard is ideal for extended movie viewing, office work, or creative projects

items.label: Dual Camera + Dual-Band Wi-Fi
items.value: Our tablet features a 5MP + 8MP dual-camera setup for HD video calls and dual stereo speakers. It supports 2.4GHz/5GHz dual-band Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0, and GPS positioning, along with facial unlock, split-screen multitasking, and wireless screen mirroring

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: A 10.1-inch Tablet, A Plastic Protective Film and a User's Manual, A US Power Adapter and Type-C Data Cable, A wireless mouse and a Bluetooth keyboard, Protective Case
